meaning: Best-fit schematic choices; no metric survey or generated panoramas/3D

assumptions.selected_hypothesis: The shelving doorway opens back into the starting study.
assumptions.rationale: Matching shelving and lamp plus nearby route position.

assumptions.test_prediction: A linking view should show bath and bedroom face a slightly staggered section of the same hall; other room outlines continue simply.

assumptions.test_prediction: A linking view should show bedroom 2 has its own internal bath and walk-in closet.
